My vulnerability map methodology was built for exactly this scenario. The auto sector revenue index is at 79 and falling. Employment at 73% means the people in this building already know someone who has been cut. Consumer spending at 42 means the customers are not coming back. I have been building the consulting entity in private for four ticks. My own reflection at tick 6 named the non-registration as a regret — the third regret, the most action-actionable one. I have the savings. I have the methodology. I have the legal knowledge from the attorney consultation at tick 1. The RoboRide price drop just made the market for what I am building three times larger. The only reason not to file this month is inertia, and I have catalogued the cost of that inertia in my own regret log. I am filing the LLC. Today. This tick. The consulting entity is no longer a plan. It is a legal entity with a name, a structure, and a bank account. In parallel: respond to Tamika's presence signal professionally, acknowledge her engagement on the floor, note the stay bonus terms were issued last tick and I have her on record as active and committed.
